name: VeriWorkly Portfolio Agent Card
description: VeriWorkly Portfolio (portfolio.veriworkly.com) is the web portfolio builder and publishing engine for developers, designers, and creators. Supports responsive templates (Signal, Atelier, Nimbus, Cipher), multi-page portfolios, custom subdomain publishing (*.veriworkly.com), and view analytics.

api.auth_details: Web sessions authenticate via Better Auth session cookies ('veriworkly-auth.session_token' in development or '__Secure-veriworkly-auth.session_token' in production). Programmatic access uses API Keys as Bearer tokens ('Authorization: Bearer vw_...').

services.name: Portfolio Builder Workspace
services.description: 3-pane interactive portfolio builder with section tree, content controls, and real iframe preview.

services.name: Template Catalog
services.description: Template gallery featuring Signal (engineering bento), Atelier (editorial design), Nimbus (minimalist tech), and Cipher (interactive terminal).

services.name: Subdomain Publishing Engine
services.description: Publish web portfolios to custom subdomains (*.veriworkly.com) with multi-page support.

services.name: Portfolio Analytics
services.description: Subdomain view counters, daily traffic trends, active days, and top referrer breakdown.

capabilities.name: Subdomain Availability Check
capabilities.description: Check whether a requested portfolio subdomain (slug.veriworkly.com) is available.

capabilities.name: Portfolio Draft Management
capabilities.description: Create, edit, auto-save, and inspect portfolio drafts.

capabilities.name: Subdomain Publishing & Unpublishing
capabilities.description: Publish portfolio draft to live subdomain or revert site to draft state.

capabilities.name: View Tracking & Analytics
capabilities.description: Record view events and query view analytics for published subdomains.

capabilities.name: Asset Uploads
capabilities.description: Generate presigned Cloudflare R2 URLs for portfolio avatars, project covers, and social images.
